verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an inference and fine-tuning platform whose REST API and firectl let users automate management of models, deployments, and datasets. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back those automated configurations is a plausible capability for this kind of platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review/approval history, or rollback of automations or deployment configs. Programmatic management APIs are only building blocks and earn no credit.
